product.name: Aion Rubix
product.description: A digital banking platform enabling creation of digital-first and digital-only banking ecosystems with real-time data exchange and end-to-end digital user experience.

product.name: Digital Onboarding
product.description: A solution for customer onboarding that digitizes and accelerates the process, enabling onboarding in under five minutes.

product.name: Retail Digital Bank
product.description: A comprehensive retail banking product suite offering seamless customer journeys to enhance engagement and retention.

product.name: Corporate Digital Bank
product.description: A digital banking suite tailored for SMEs and corporate clients, featuring onboarding, lending, payments, and cash management.

product.name: Aion Hikmah (Artificial Intelligence Platform)
product.description: An AI platform providing actionable insights through analytics, machine learning, and data enrichment to support revenue growth and customer retention.

product.name: Open Banking Platform
product.description: An API-driven platform connecting banks and data providers globally to enable open banking and financial ecosystem integration.
